key_facts: UPDATED Aug 21 (T+1d to Sat Aug 22 opening night at Ice Ribbon; Exa Global Times/ThePrint/CGTN/Open Video Aug 19-21 + local Irish Times/Straits Times/NDTV Aug 21; SUBMITTED Honor Flash 0.27->0.30, Tiangong Ultra 0.11->0.16, Unitree H1 0.13->0.12, Unitree Superman 0.16->0.11, MirrorMe Bolt 0.06->0.05; sum=0.740, outside=0.260): Opening-eve reporting confirms 2,056 robots from 666 teams across 16 countries, opening Saturday evening Aug 22 with 100m & 400m heats under strict 100% fully autonomous rules (no teleoperation; 100m time limit cut from 3 min to 1 min). Key updates: (1) HONOR FLASH (0.30): Confirmed 100m/400m/1,500m entrant (CGTN/Open Video Aug 19), +10cm legs, lighter materials, replica 100m track training, hip-mounted pure visual camera for lane-keeping, clocking ~10s and targeting Usain Bolt's 9.58s; clear #1 operational favorite but capped at 0.30 given high autonomous sprint fall/crash/DQ variance (NDTV Aug 21 highlighted viral training crash into cushion wall). (2) TIANGONG ULTRA (0.16, UP from 0.11): Global Times (Aug 21 23:33 Beijing time) confirms defending 2025 autonomous 100m champ X-Humanoid is on-site entering 4 robots (Tien Kung Ultra, Tien Kung 3.0, Tien Kung Omni, Tianyi 2.0) with upgraded joints, lighter wind-cutting body, fast-acceleration 100m algorithms, and upgraded localization & mapping replacing last year's lane-line tracking. (3) UNITREE SUPERMAN (0.11, DOWN from 0.16): Despite Aug 17 12.66 m/s promo video ahead of Unitree's Aug 19 Shanghai IPO (+460%), neither Global Times nor ThePrint Aug 21 trackside previews mention Superman entering the Games (prototype developed in ~3 months with no confirmed autonomous 100m start). (4) UNITREE H1 (0.12): Proven 2025 Games platform fielded by multiple teams (10.1 m/s Apr autonomous test). (5) MIRRORME BOLT (0.05): Feb 10 m/s sprinter, no Aug 19-21 pre-Games confirmation. Outside mass 0.26 covers Tien Kung 3.0/Omni, Robot Era, Unitree H2/G1, and surprise entrants.
